source.name: GEM365 AI Auto-filler & Auditor for Dynamics 365 Business Central

mapping.summary: AI reads attachments and audits them against BC records
claims: Uses Azure AI to read attachments, depending on document type
Works on purchase, sales, vendor, customer, released production order and transfer order records
Custom document sub types, for example quote, invoice, manifest, bill of lading and proof of delivery
Extraction via live dialog or background job queue
Same file never sent to Azure twice
Compares header fields and lines both ways against attachments
AI judge with confidence score recognises equivalent terms
Reads complementary attachments like invoice plus bill of lading together
Bulk upload drafts a fully proposed document
Side-by-side review of auto-filled form and attachment
Vendor/customer matching by VAT number, name, word match, short name then AI
Matches printed wordings and article numbers to items; creates new items in one click
Unmatched lines get filled from posting history, the document, text-to-account mapping or an AI suggestion
Collapses repeated charges posted to the same G/L account to one line
Learns per vendor/customer defaults, editable and deletable
Nothing written without user confirmation
Runs on customer's own Azure subscription; no data routed through publisher
API keys held in Isolated Storage
Requires Azure AI Document Intelligence subscription
Needs the Premium edition for the released production order features
